test: crates/kernel/src/tests.rs: similar_spheres_meet (PR #838, the fix); crates/engine/src/tests.rs: join_of_two_overlapping_equal_spheres_is_not_refused (PR #836, on top of it)
summary: Union of two spheres of radius 10, which SolidCraft refused with 'contact work exceeds the limit' (centres 12 and 4 mm apart, per the issue). The overlap is a lens of volume pi (4r + d)(2r - d)^2 / 12. d 12 is the engine test's join; d 4 and d 20.5 are positions from the kernel test, which checks only whether the spheres meet, so their volumes and lump counts here are closed form. The tangent position d 20 is left out (point contact). Tolerance 0.01 mm^3.

cases.name: overlapping_equal_spheres_d12
cases.note: Two spheres of radius 10 with centres 12 mm apart.

cases.name: overlapping_equal_spheres_d4
cases.note: Two spheres of radius 10 with centres 4 mm apart.

cases.name: separate_equal_spheres_d20_5
cases.note: Control: centres 20.5 mm apart do not touch (the kernel test's `meets` = false); the union keeps two lumps.
